find: if (marker && marker[1][0] === fence[0] && marker[1].length >= fence.length && !marker[2].trim()) fence = undefined;

for (const row of rows) console.warn("::warning::extra");

name: observation-not-future
find: if (timestamp > today + DAY) failures.push(`${at}: the Observed date is more than one UTC day ahead of today.`);
test: rejects an observation more than one UTC day ahead

name: regeneration-not-future
find: if (timestamp > today + DAY) failures.push(`${file}:${generatedLine + 1}: Last regenerated date is more than one UTC day ahead of today.`);
test: rejects a regeneration date more than one UTC day ahead

name: observation-tomorrow-allowed
find: if (timestamp > today + DAY) failures.push(`${at}: the Observed date is more than one UTC day ahead of today.`);
replace: if (timestamp >= today + DAY) failures.push(`${at}: the Observed date is more than one UTC day ahead of today.`);
test: allows an observation and regeneration stamp one UTC day ahead

name: regeneration-tomorrow-allowed
find: if (timestamp > today + DAY) failures.push(`${file}:${generatedLine + 1}: Last regenerated date is more than one UTC day ahead of today.`);
replace: if (timestamp >= today + DAY) failures.push(`${file}:${generatedLine + 1}: Last regenerated date is more than one UTC day ahead of today.`);
test: allows an observation and regeneration stamp one UTC day ahead
